package.name: helios_obstacle_detection
package.description: Perception-only LiDAR stack for the RoboSense Helios 32 (LiDAR data only, no camera / GPS / IMU): ROI + load-adaptive voxel filtering, concentric-zone (Patchwork++-style) ground segmentation, range-adaptive clustering, oriented 3D boxes, LiDAR-only ego-motion estimation, Kalman/Hungarian multi-object tracking with moving/static classification, velocity/heading estimation, uncertainty-aware TTC / risk grading, sensor data-loss and latency analysis, diagnostics, RViz2 visualisation, offline benchmark and tests. Publishes no actuation commands.
